# Playgama - Gaming Portal & Distribution Platform

## About Playgama
Playgama operates in two key areas:

### 1. Online Gaming Portal
A leading gaming portal offering 30,000+ free-to-play HTML5 browser games, providing instant entertainment to 300 million monthly players worldwide. Players can access games directly through their web browsers without any downloads or installations required. The portal features comprehensive game organization with 200+ categories, 500+ tags, and 50+ game series.

### 2. Game Distribution Platform
A comprehensive distribution platform for HTML5 game developers, providing global reach through the unified Playgama Bridge SDK. Developers can integrate once and instantly distribute their games across 15+ partner platforms, reaching hundreds of millions of users with streamlined monetization and analytics.

## Key Statistics
### Gaming Portal
- 30,000+ HTML5 browser games
- 300 million monthly players worldwide
- Free-to-play model
- 200+ game categories
- 500+ game tags
- 50+ game series
- 9 language localizations

### Distribution Platform
- 15+ partner platforms 
- 3,500+ developers using SDK
- Global distribution network
- Unified development solution
- Revenue sharing model

## Main Game Categories
- [.io Games](https://playgama.com/category/io): Multiplayer browser games with simple mechanics
- [Action](https://playgama.com/category/action): Fast-paced adventure and combat games
- [Puzzle](https://playgama.com/category/puzzle): Brain teasers and logic games
- [Arcade](https://playgama.com/category/arcade): Classic arcade-style games
- [Sports](https://playgama.com/category/sports): Football, basketball, soccer games
- [Strategy](https://playgama.com/category/strategy): Tower defense and tactical games
- [Simulation](https://playgama.com/category/simulation): Life simulation and business games
- [Skill](https://playgama.com/category/skill): Reflex and coordination games
- [Bubble Shooter](https://playgama.com/category/bubble-shooter): Classic bubble-popping mechanics
- [For Girls](https://playgama.com/category/girls): Fashion and dress-up games
- [2 Player](https://playgama.com/category/two-player): Local multiplayer games
- [For Boys](https://playgama.com/category/boys): Adventure and action-oriented games
- [Horror](https://playgama.com/category/horror): Scary and suspenseful games
- [Car](https://playgama.com/category/car): Racing and driving games
- [Funny](https://playgama.com/category/funny): Humorous and comedic games
- [Multiplayer](https://playgama.com/category/multiplayer): Online multiplayer experiences
- [Shooting](https://playgama.com/category/shooting): Target practice and space shooters
- [Snake](https://playgama.com/category/snake): Classic snake game variations
- [Gun](https://playgama.com/category/gun): Weapon-based action games
- [Clicker](https://playgama.com/category/clicker): Incremental and idle games
- [Solitaire](https://playgama.com/category/solitaire): Card game variations

## Playgama Bridge SDK
- Unified SDK for cross-platform HTML5 game publishing
- [Documentation](https://wiki.playgama.com/playgama): Complete SDK documentation and guides
- One SDK integration for 15+ partner platforms
- Used by 3,500+ developers worldwide
- Free and open-source development kit
- Supports all major game engines

### Supported Game Engines
- [Unity](https://wiki.playgama.com/playgama/sdk/engines/unity/intro): Unity WebGL integration guide
- [Godot 3 & 4](https://wiki.playgama.com/playgama/sdk/engines/godot/intro): Godot plugin-based integration
- [Construct 3](https://wiki.playgama.com/playgama/sdk/engines/construct-3/intro): Visual scripting integration
- [GDevelop](https://wiki.playgama.com/playgama/sdk/engines/gdevelop/intro): Extension-based integration
- [Game Maker](https://wiki.playgama.com/playgama/sdk/engines/game-maker/intro): HTML5 export compatibility
- [Defold](https://wiki.playgama.com/playgama/sdk/engines/defold/intro): Native Defold integration
- [Cocos Creator](https://wiki.playgama.com/playgama/sdk/engines/cocos-creator/intro): TypeScript and JS support
- [Plain JavaScript](https://wiki.playgama.com/playgama/sdk/engines/core-plain-js/intro): Core JS implementation

### Supported Platforms (15+)
- Playgama, Crazy Games, Game Distribution
- Yandex Games, Y8, PlayDeck
- Telegram Games, Discord, Reddit Games
- YouTube Playables, Tiktok, Facebook Gaming
- MSN Games, Microsoft Games
- Xiaomi Game Center, Huawei Game Center, Samsung Instant Games
